title: Bias–Variance Tradeoff — Read the Two Learning Curves
key_insight: High errors together suggest too much bias. A large gap suggests too much variance.
body:
## Read the Two Learning Curves

Training error and validation error stay high together, or training becomes excellent while validation remains poor.

High errors together suggest too much bias. A large gap suggests too much variance.

More flexible features can reduce bias. More data, regularization, or a simpler model can reduce variance, but diagnose before choosing a remedy.
common_mistakes: Choosing a remedy without comparing training and validation behavior.
Assuming model size alone determines effective complexity.
mini_exercise: Draw the situation from “Read the Two Learning Curves” with three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: The tradeoff explains underfitting, overfitting, and why model complexity needs validation.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “Read the Two Learning Curves” story, explain Bias–Variance Tradeoff without assuming the listener knows machine learning.
